create_project.description: Creates one new project inside an organization and returns the created project's details.

params.name: name
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the project included in the MongoDB Cloud organization.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud organization to which the project belongs.

params.name: regionUsageRestrictions
params.description: Atlas for Government only. Restricts available regions for the project. One of COMMERCIAL_FEDRAMP_REGIONS_ONLY or GOV_REGIONS_ONLY. Default: COMMERCIAL_FEDRAMP_REGIONS_ONLY.

params.name: tags
params.description: List of key-value pairs (1-255 chars) for tagging and categorizing the project.

params.name: withDefaultAlertsSettings
params.description: Flag that indicates whether to create the project with default alert settings. Default: true.

params.name: projectOwnerId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user to grant the Project Owner role on the new project. Overrides the default of the oldest Organization Owner.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object. Default: false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default: false.

delete_project.description: Removes one project, which must have no clusters, and returns no content on success.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project to remove.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object. Default: false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default: false.

get_project.description: Returns one project by its unique ID, including cluster count, tags, and organization details.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object. Default: false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default: false.

list_projects.description: Returns all projects to which the requesting service account has access.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object. Default: false.

params.name: includeCount
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response returns the total number of items (totalCount). Default: true.

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items that the response returns per page. Minimum 1, maximum 500. Default: 100.

params.name: pageNum
params.description: Number of the page that displays the current set of the total objects that the response returns. Minimum 1. Default: 1.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default: false.

update_project.description: Updates the name, tags, or default alert settings of one project and returns the updated project.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project to update.

params.name: name
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the project included in the MongoDB Cloud organization.

params.name: tags
params.description: List of key-value pairs (1-255 chars) for tagging and categorizing the project.

params.name: withDefaultAlertsSettings
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the project can automatically create default alerts.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object. Default: false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default: false.

get_cluster.description: Returns the full configuration and status details for one cluster identified by project (groupId) and cluster name.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project (group). Format: ^([a-f0-9]{24})$.

params.name: clusterName
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies this cluster. Format: ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Wraps the response in an envelope JSON object. Default false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default false.

params.name: Use-Effective-Instance-Fields
params.description: Header. Controls whether hardware specification fields return original client-specified values (with separate effective fields) or current operational values directly. Default false.

params.name: Use-Effective-Fields-Replication-Specs
params.description: Header. Controls whether replicationSpecs returns the client-specified view (with separate effectiveReplicationSpecs) or the actual cluster state directly. Default false.
